title: Multi-LLM Query Optimization
summary: Deploying multiple large language models (LLMs) in parallel to classify an unknown ground-truth label is a common practice, yet the problem of optimally allocating queries across heterogeneous models remains poorly understood. In this paper, we formulate a robust, offline query-planning problem that minimizes total query cost subject to statewise error constraints which guarantee reliability for every possible ground-truth label.
